_about: The named constants of autoware_vehicle_msgs/msg/GearReport as the tests' stand-in message class carries them (tests/test_sdv_rosvss.py): the names the feeder's gear mapping is specified on (spec 2.8) with the values of autoware_msgs' GearReport.msg as written from the single source, unread at Autoware 1.9.0's pin here (WP4a reads them with ros2 interface show). The mapping works on the names; the values only pair a report with its name.
